title: Onomappu — タメ語と話し言葉 (Casual Speech and Contractions in Japanese)
description: From Onomappu. Covers the casual speech register used between friends, in manga, and in anime: dropped particles, contracted forms (ている→てる、てしまう→ちゃう、ておく→とく), sentence-final particles (ね、よ、な、さ、わ), masculine vs. feminine speech markers, and the difference between タメ語 (plain form) and です・ます. Essential for understanding real spoken Japanese.
creator: Onomappu
